slides.headline: WhatsApp Must Be Tied to Your Phone's SIM From 1 January 2027
slides.photo_credit: Photo: Paowee / Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

slides.stat_label: What Could Stop Working on WhatsApp
bullets: WhatsApp on a tablet or spare phone with no SIM, on Wi-Fi
A phone whose registered SIM is removed, swapped or not recharged
Same rule for Telegram, Signal, Arattai, ShareChat, Josh, JioChat

slides.stat_label: Deadline for WhatsApp and Other Apps to Tie Accounts to Your SIM
bullets: Telecom Department says it targets scams run from abroad on Indian numbers
The November 2025 order first gave apps 90 days; that was extended
WhatsApp Web: no fixed 6-hour logout; fraud-risk checks decide instead
slides.credit_line: Sources: Inc42, Digit, Outlook Business, All India Radio
